title: Canonical isomorphism between L-eta_I(M) tensored with O_X/I and the Bockstein complex H^bullet(M/I)
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on the eta construction on complexes
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the canonical isomorphism L-eta_I M tensor^L O_X/I = H^bullet(M/I) in D(O_X), where the right-hand side is the Bockstein complex. The proof reduces to I-torsion free representatives using the construction of L-eta, computes the tensor product as eta_I F^bullet tensor O_X/I, then writes a local generator f of I and a local section s = f^i s' and shows that d^i maps it to zero in F^{i+1} tensor I^i/I^{i+1}, which yields a map of complexes to H^i(F^bullet tensor I^i/I^{i+1}) (proof lines 14442-14472). Compatibility with differentials is a calculation, and the identification with the algebraic model is made stalkwise (proof lines 14474-14478). H2: the explicit section-level construction of the map and the differential check are the substance; there is no missing argument.
